title: NOLLI: A Difficulty-Calibrated English-Korean Puzzle Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.04397v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce NOLLI, a procedurally generated, difficulty-calibrated English-Korean puzzle benchmark with 15 puzzle types (25 tasks; 7,500 items). Each instance is seed-regenerable, has a verified unique solution, and is scored deterministically. We calibrate difficulty behaviorally by tuning generator parameters to target accuracy bands on a reference model. NOLLI has three task families: matched direct translations, script adaptations over Hangul jamo (sub-syllabic letters), and Korean-only cultural or orthographic tasks. We evaluate 15 frontier, open-weight, and Korean-developed models; gap analyses use the 12 above a 3% overall-accuracy floor. On matched direct translations, English and Korean accuracy is equivalent within a prespecified $\pm 10$ percentage-point margin. Script adaptations behave differently: Korean Cipher trails English by up to 68.7 percentage points, while Cryptarithmetic over the same jamo shows no systematic

translated_title: NOLLI：一个难度校准的英韩谜题基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了NOLLI，一个程序化生成、难度经过校准的英韩双语谜题基准，包含15种谜题类型（25个任务；7500个题目）。每个实例可通过种子再生，具有经验证的唯一解，并以确定性方式评分。我们通过调节生成器参数以在参考模型上达到目标准确率区间，从而实现行为层面的难度校准。NOLLI包含三个任务族：匹配的直接翻译任务、基于韩文字母（jamo，即亚音节字母）的文字系统改编任务，以及仅限韩语的文化或正字法任务。我们评估了15个前沿模型、开源权重模型及韩国开发的模型；差距分析使用了整体准确率高于3%下限的12个模型。在匹配的直接翻译任务上，英语和韩语的准确率在预设的±10个百分点范围内等效。文字改编任务则表现不同：韩语密码任务落后英语最多达68.7个百分点，而在相同字母上的密码算术任务未表现出系统性的……
tldr: 本文提出了NOLLI——首个程序化生成、难度经过行为校准的英韩双语谜题基准，通过7500个具有唯一解的可再生题目揭示出前沿模型在英韩直接翻译上表现相当，但在涉及韩文字母的文字改编任务上存在高达68.7个百分点的显著差距。
en_tdlr: NOLLI is a procedurally generated, difficulty-calibrated English-Korean puzzle benchmark with 15 puzzle types and 7,500 uniquely-solvable regenerable items, revealing that frontier models achieve equivalent accuracy on direct translations but trail by up to 68.7 percentage points on Hangul script-adaptation tasks.
